title: Chapter 46 Fangling County (Plus One)
content:
Chapter 46 Fangling County (Plus One)

"System, exchange me for a mid-level scribe and a mid-level general."

As Zhong Yu's voice fell, two figures appeared in the hall under his main seat. Those two figures looked around, saw himself sitting at the head of the hall, and hurriedly bowed down.

"Subordinates, Zhao Xin, Zhang Lie, pay my respects to the lord."

It turned out that the mid-level scribe was called Zhao Xin, and the mid-level general was called Zhang Lie.

"Very good, I asked you to come here, it is exactly what my territory needs. There is a county magistrate, and the county captain is vacant, and I need you to fill it."

When they heard that they had obtained such an important position when they first arrived, both of them were overjoyed.

"I will not dare to forget, I will work hard, guard this piece of foundation for the lord, and dare not bear the favor of the lord."

He hurriedly replied, because he was afraid that if he hesitated so much, he would run away with a fat job.

"Well, that's good, you go down, I will arrange someone to take you to understand the situation of the territory? Then you can take over as soon as possible."

Afterwards, Zhong Yu summoned five junior scribes and ten junior generals, and asked them to go down with the two intermediate talents.

Three days later, all the affairs of the territory were arranged by Zhong Yu, Zhao Xin and Zhang Lie also took over the positions of county magistrate and county lieutenant, and other civil and military positions in the county were also filled.

The redundant people will temporarily serve as the deputy positions of other chiefs to accumulate experience, and when there are vacancies, they can be filled in time without any panic or inexperienced mistakes.

And Zhong Yu, with his 100 knights, came to the center of the square in the territory, and told the system that he would go to the road of conquest of other worlds.

Many people may be a little strange. Didn't you say that you will summon 2,000 soldiers? What about those people?

In fact, Zhong Yu asked the system later, and it turns out that those soldiers can also be summoned in the Three Kingdoms world.

After all, there is not much difference between the world of the Three Kingdoms and this world, they are both worlds to be conquered by Zhong Yu, but there are some differences in their power levels.

It's just that because of the different regions, he needs to pay him 10% extra luck points.

Therefore, Zhong Yu can go to the Three Kingdoms world, choose a place he wants to start an incident, summon the two thousand troops, and give the people in that place a surprise attack, which will definitely have an unexpected effect.

"System, start crossing, crossing location, Fangling County, Hanzhong County."

"Confirm the time travel, time travel begins."

Following a flash of white light, Zhong Yu and the 100 elite knights around him disappeared in front of all the citizens.

In the sixth year of Guanghe in the Eastern Han Dynasty, July. In Yizhou Cishi Department, Fangling County in the east of Hanzhong County. In a lush forest, a burst of white light suddenly flashed.

Zhong Yu and his knights appeared in this bamboo forest. Suddenly a large group of people appeared, and the surrounding birds and beasts were startled and scattered in all directions.

According to the "Hanshu" records, in the fifth year of Yonghe (140 years) of Emperor Shun of the Han Dynasty, there were 57,344 households and a population of 267,402. Leading counties 13: Nanzheng County, Chenggu County, Xicheng County, Baozhong County, Mianyang County, Anyang County, Xi County, Shangyong County, Fangling County, Xunyang County, Xi County, Wuling County, Changli County .

In just one county, there are 13 counties with a population of nearly 270,000, and an average of nearly 20,000 people in one county.

Fangling County is now located in the easternmost part of Hanzhong County, with a vast land and few people. The territory of one county is equivalent to the other 3 or 4 counties, and the population is relatively large, with about 30,000 people.

Zhongyu is now in the east of Fangling County, separated from Jingzhou by the Han River. To the north is Nanxiang County in Nanyang County of Jingzhou, to the east is Feng County, to the south is the mountains, across the mountains is Bajun County, and to the west is Shangyong County.

The east and north are blocked by the Han River. As long as you guard the dangerous crossing, you can defend against the threat from Jingzhou.

So I only need to concentrate on attacking the west, open up land, and establish my own territory.

My current goal is Fangling County. And in order not to leak the news before he can occupy Fangling County, it is necessary to block the road and set up a wide range of checkpoints.

In the general system of each county in the Han Dynasty, there were five townships in a large county and three townships in a small county. The township pavilions in the Han Dynasty were called the southeast, northwest, or upper and lower townships according to the different regions, and the township where the county seat was located was called Duxiang, which means the capital city.

The current location I am in is Dongxiang. Among the five townships in Fangling County, it has the largest area and the second largest population, with a population of about 8,000 people. This number can already be compared with some small counties.

But now, what I should consider is how to annex the entire Dongxiang without leaking the news. I just photographed a few cavalrymen to inquire about the news.

They have returned now, and I am not worried about their communication with the villagers. Also born in the Han Dynasty to them, it should be possible for basic communication.

Moreover, their clothes are very deceptive. They are all wearing the military uniforms of the Central Army of the Han Dynasty. It is still okay to confuse these uneducated people in the countryside.

As long as you can block the entire Hanshui River, detain merchants who come and go, and set up checkpoints along the road, pedestrians are not allowed to pass through.

As for Jingzhou, they don't have to worry about it for at least three months. They have already occupied the entire Fangling County.

As for the West, as long as they keep attacking quickly and don't give them time to react, then there is no big problem.

I asked the cavalry who had just come back from inquiring about the news. Fifteen miles east of my side was the first pavilion of Dongxiang.

Because Dongxiang is located on the edge of the Han River, merchants come and go around, and the land is very fertile after being irrigated by the Han River, so the tax is very high. The imperial court specially established a city guard army with a number of about 100 people stationed in Dongxiang.

The Dongxiang Government is located in a small city with a wall height of five meters. There are about 1,000 people living in it. Because it is the only city within dozens of miles around, the city is still relatively prosperous.

Now that I have a general understanding of the surrounding situation, what I have to consider now is how to get close to the small town of Dongxiang without disturbing the 100-man army in the city.

However, this time I happened to bring 100 cavalrymen, and they were all wearing the uniforms of the Han Central Army, so I could help the Central Army come to the local area for business.

Go directly to the small town of Dongxiang with the cavalry in an open and aboveboard manner. Presumably those people along the road dare not stop me, and I have reached the city.

Direct raid, let the guards lead the cavalry into the city before they can react, capture the county government, and create an established fact, then you can successfully take over the entire Dongxiang.

After planning the next tactics, Zhong Yu directly led his cavalry to Dongxiang City. Seeing pedestrians on the road along the way, they didn't give way, and went on a rampage all the way.

The common people along the way, the merchants who came and went, all hurried on the road and dared not speak, and they were all surprised in their hearts. Which military master from a big city is this? They are all cavalry, and they are all wearing expensive armor.

In the Han Dynasty, generally only officers who lead fifty or hundreds of soldiers can wear the armor of those cavalry, but now there are a group of hundreds of cavalry, no wonder they are guessing in their hearts.

I'm in a bad mood today, and the third watch will make everyone feel better.
